home.headline: Good rooms meet great live acts.
home.body: A private marketplace where venues and small-format talent book with clear terms, calendars, and contact privacy.
home.proofFallback: Creating opportunities for artists and venues in local communities.
home.featuredLocalBody: We're here to create more opportunities for artists where they live. By connecting talent with local venues, we help communities build vibrant entertainment cultures without relying on imports from far away.
home.featuredFlowTitle: One clear path from discovery to confirmed booking
home.featuredFlowBody: No scattered emails or calendar chaos. Applications and direct requests follow the same flow—terms, agreement, confirmation—with both calendars blocked and contacts protected until mutual interest.
home.audienceCardTalentBody: Discover local venues, build your calendar, keep contacts private until the right opportunity.
home.audienceCardBuyersBody: Find local acts, post open calls, confirm bookings with clear agreements and honest calendars.
home.principle1Body: Profiles stay members-only. Contacts unlock only after shortlist or an accepted direct request.
home.principle2Body: Applications and direct requests share one terms, agreement, and confirmation flow.
home.principle3Body: Native holds and confirmed blocks keep both calendars honest before the night.
home.footerNote: Salon is a private B2B marketplace. Not a consumer event platform.

forTalent.metaDescription: Discover local venues, build your calendar, and book with confidence. A private marketplace supporting artists where they live.
forTalent.headline: More opportunities where you live.
forTalent.body: Connect with local venues that fit your act. Keep your contact private until the right booking. Build a calendar you can trust.
forTalent.problemBody: Finding the right local venues means scattered directories, cold emails, and crossed calendars. Opportunities slip through the cracks. Contact info gets harvested. Double bookings happen.
forTalent.solution1Body: Browse curated local venues by type, capacity, production setup, and location. Filter by what matters to your act. Your contact stays private until they shortlist you or you accept their request.
forTalent.solution2Body: Respond to open calls or send direct proposals with your terms. One clear flow—offer, agreement, confirmation—with your calendar blocked only when both sides sign.
forTalent.solution3Body: Holds expire. Confirmed bookings block both calendars. No mystery about whether a date is really available. Your availability is your truth, and venues can see it.
forTalent.categoriesBody: Music · Comedy · Dance · Theatre & spoken word · Variety & circus · Visual & multimedia · Hosting & facilitation

forBuyers.metaDescription: Discover local talent, post open calls, and book with clear agreements. A private marketplace supporting venues and entertainment businesses.
forBuyers.headline: Support local talent, fill your calendar.
forBuyers.body: Discover artists in your community. Post opportunities and review applications. Confirm bookings with clear agreements and calendars that don't lie.
forBuyers.problemBody: Finding local acts that fit your room means scattered searches, email negotiations, and no guarantee they'll show. Quality is inconsistent. Calendars are unreliable. Last-minute cancellations leave you scrambling.
forBuyers.solution1Body: Browse curated artists by category, format, fee range, and availability. Filter for acts that fit your production setup. Keep your contact private until you're ready to reach out.
forBuyers.solution2Body: List dated opportunities or standing needs. Review applications without exposing your contact info. Shortlist candidates and start conversations when you find the right fit.
forBuyers.solution3Body: One flow from offer to confirmed booking. Both parties sign the agreement. Both calendars get blocked. No ambiguity about terms, no double bookings, no surprises.
forBuyers.venueTypesBody: Bar & club · Café & restaurant · Theatre & stage · Gallery & museum · Cultural spaces
